sources.title: Washington L&I Verify a Contractor, Tradesperson or Business
sources.supports: Official portal to confirm contractor registration, bond, and insurance.

sources.title: Kirkland Municipal Code 21.06.215 — Work exempt from permit
sources.supports: Exempts painting, papering, tiling, carpeting, cabinets, countertops and similar finish work if accessibility features are not altered; exemptions do not apply in flood hazard, critical areas/buffers, or WUI locations.

sources.title: Kirkland Municipal Code 21.06.210 — Electrical permit required
sources.supports: Electrical permit required for installation, alteration, repair, replacement, modification or maintenance of electrical systems regardless of voltage (Ch. 19.28 RCW).

sources.title: Kirkland Municipal Code 21.06.247 — Verification of contractor registration
sources.supports: Applicant must provide contractor registration number and Kirkland business license number before permit issuance.

sources.title: Washington L&I — Cities that do their own electrical permits and inspections
sources.supports: Lists Kirkland (123 Fifth Ave) among cities issuing their own electrical permits and inspections.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit.com
sources.supports: Shared online permit portal; Kirkland listed among participating jurisdictions.

sources.title: Fine Homebuilding — The Basics of Makeup Air
sources.supports: IRC makeup-air history for kitchen hoods over 400 cfm (2009 requirement; 2018 tied to fuel-fired appliances).
